content_metadata.description: A video featuring Francisca Valenzuela discussing why she fights racism, emphasizing equality, diversity, inclusion, and the need for social change.

text_to_speech: why do I fight racism because we are all equal as human beings and deserve respect dignity no matter the color of our skin where we come from our our physical condition our sexual orientation or gender or our class and the ways I fight racism is through my work through my art for my creations and as a citizen I March I vote I participate I encourage you all to fight racism fight intolerance and make this world a place of actual respect integration and celebration of diversity

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Because we are all equal as human beings and deserve respect, dignity, no matter the color of our skin,
where we come from, our physical condition, our sexual orientation or our gender, or our class.
And the ways I fight racism is through my work, through my art, through my creations,
and as a citizen I march, I vote, I participate.
I encourage you all to fight racism, fight intolerance, and make this world a place of actual respect,

youtube_description: On this International Day for the Elimination of Racial Discrimination, all of us must stand up to promote respect, compassion and equality for all. Watch the videos of our influencers against racism and support the elimination of racial discrimination. #FightRacism #StandUp4HumanRights
